title: MCP++ PortableError@1
description: Portable, content-addressable error carrier for MCP++ execution outcomes. Cross-language and cross-trust-domain; maps to transport/RPC codes without becoming transport-specific. Interface: PortableError@1. Normative prose: ipfs_accelerate_py/mcplusplus/docs/spec/execution-envelope.md.
$comment: Interface label: PortableError@1. Schema marker: mcp++/execution/portable-error@1. Structural acceptance only; retry policy and security classification are enforced by executors and higher conformance levels.

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code (e.g. E_POLICY_DENIED, E_AUTHORITY_EXPIRED, E_FENCED_STALE).

message.description: Human-readable summary. MUST NOT embed secrets, plaintext confidential artifacts, or raw credentials.

retryable.description: Whether a conformant executor MAY retry the same envelope under the declared retry policy. permanent/policy/authority failures SHOULD set false.

failure_class.description: Coarse failure taxonomy shared with Profile G receipts and durable-executor recovery.

path.description: Optional JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) into the envelope, intent, or input that caused the error.

details_cid.description: CID of a structured details object (stack frames, rule ids, resource quotas). Null when no details blob is published.

cause_cids.description: CIDs of prior PortableError@1 (or related) records that caused this error.

rpc_code.description: Optional JSON-RPC / MCP application error code mapping (e.g. -32602).

http_status.description: Optional HTTP status mapping when the error crosses an HTTP binding.

observed_at_ms.description: Wall-clock observation time in Unix epoch milliseconds. Informational only; causal order uses parents and logical clocks.

correlation_id.description: Optional correlation hook matching the parent envelope/result when available.

cid.description: IPFS CID. CIDv1 base32 (b…) preferred for new mints; CIDv0 (Qm…) remains readable when historical.

failureClass.description: Shared failure taxonomy. Aligns with Profile G TaskReceipt.failure_class plus portable timeout/cancel/internal classes.
